findings.summary: IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md is stale relative to the reworked implementation it documents: it is headed "attempt 1", claims 18 new cases / 6 files / 79 tests (the tree now holds 20 cases in test/generate.test.ts and 81 total), and its spec §8 mutation echo for Q3 cites deleting a `tryLockSynthesizer` guard — a construct that no longer exists after the lock was changed to serializing wait-then-run (`lockSynthesizer`). The §8 attribution record therefore was not re-run against the reworked lock. This does not leave the risk uncovered: the D6 case in test/generate.test.ts:163-208 drives a second orchestration while the first synthesizer is suspended, asserts no second spawn during contention, and asserts the second pass still spawns the synthesizer after release — a lock-less variant would spawn twice at the 20ms checkpoint and be killed.

Acceptance row D18 (npm run typecheck / npm test exit 0) still has no committed evidence at this subject: .dd-evidence/acceptance.json records the previous package dev_ledr_s3_terminate_01 (input/subject f0b621b4, 5 files / 61 tests) and predates src/generate.ts, and the only in-tree claim (IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md "6 files / 79 tests") provably predates the current 81-case tree. D19 by contrast is statically corroborated: the per-file counts protocol 11 + bus 10 + tick 16 + cas 5 + s3 19 = 61 match the S3 acceptance record exactly, so no pre-existing case was deleted, and all 20 new cases live in the new test/generate.test.ts.
